Where to begin?! I’ve been to Be Vang before and after their remodel and the food has always been consistently top notch. The restaurant interior is very clean, comfortable, and their staff is welcoming and kind. This is more of a fine dining establishment and both the menu items and impeccable service reflect this type of experience. Plus they are great with kids which is so very appreciated! They took great care to provide us a high chair, and were attentive to their needs such as giving us plastic cups and kids utensils.

As for the food, I am incredibly impressed by the selection ranging from seafood and sushi to Western and Vietnamese delicacies. I live in a huge metropolis in the US where we have access to the best chefs and restaurants in the world. But I always look forward to Be Vang when we come to this area. We have sampled most of their offerings and everything is just fresh and well prepared. On our most recent visit we did a surf n turf with a deluxe sushi boat and steak - it was amazingly good and the owner even mentioned the fish gets imported from Japan. My kids devoured the sashimi. The steak was cooked to a perfect medium rare and melted in your mouth…I am still thinking about it days later. 

I see that the restaurant has lots of local Vietnamese patronizing them in addition to foreigners which is a great sign that they do a good job of accommodating all kinds of people. It seems to be somewhat of a hidden gem but I think they rival even the best Michelin restaurants out there! Will keep coming back every time we visit Saigon.
